note: The AffrescoUI Launcher: the home of the example apps and of the person's own. Apps (your apps and the examples as cards, each tagged Example or Yours; a search; a click or Enter opens one), My apps (open, duplicate, show in the folder, delete after a confirm), Create (a name, a starting point, a description for the assistant, features from other apps) and Settings. It is a screen like any other, with no C++ of its own: affrescoui_launcher opens it when started without a file and grants it the folders it reads and writes (the services examples and apps) and the programs that open the apps (the service launch). Where nothing is granted (the rendering check), the services are refused and it shows the examples from apps.json and an empty My apps.

featureChoices.ask: a Kanban board with columns, cards and drag and drop, like Flow's (examples/flow)
a command palette (Cmd+K) listing the app's actions, like Flow's
charts from ../../shared/components/charts.json, like Haven's energy page
a year heatmap of daily entries, like Streak's
a settings page with declared settings, like Arcadia's
sign-in and create-account screens with checked fields, like the Sign in app's
Sinopia's slide sorter (the installable part slideSorter of app:sinopia), bound with an adapter

computed.everyApp: {{concat(map(state.mine, {id: it.id, name: it.name, modified: it.modified, mine: true}), state.examples)}}
computed.shown: {{filter(computed.everyApp, trim(state.query) == '' || contains(lower(it.name + ' ' + (it.mine ? it.id : t('tagline.' + it.id))), lower(trim(state.query))))}}
computed.askText:
{{trim(trim(state.create.describe) + (length(state.create.features) > 0 ? '

Also add these features from other apps: ' + join(map(filter(state.featureChoices, contains(state.create.features, it.id)), it.ask), '; ') + '.' : ''))}}
computed.createError: {{trim(state.create.name) == '' ? 'create.error.empty' : length(trim(state.create.name)) > 80 ? 'create.error.long' : contains(state.create.name, '{' + '{') || contains(state.create.name, '}' + '}') ? 'create.error.braces' : computed.slug == '' ? 'create.error.letters' : contains(computed.reserved, computed.slug) ? 'create.error.reserved' : contains(computed.myIds, computed.slug) ? 'create.error.exists' : length(computed.askText) > 4000 ? 'create.error.describe' : ''}}

launcher.refresh.note: Reads the apps folder again. Each read is numbered (mineRun): one started later makes an earlier one, still reading, stop, so two never fill the list together

launcher.show.note: Shows a list of the person's apps as the folder gave it (event.mine: [{id, name, modified}]): scenarios play the folder's answer with it

loadMine.note: with: i, run. Reads the apps one after another (an fs service runs 16 calls at once): each folder's screen's modified time and window title; the last changed first. A folder holds its screen, or a json folder (a copy of an example: loadMineCopy)

listNew.note: with: id, sub, title. Shows an app just made at the top of the list at once, before the folder is read again (launcher.refresh)

listNew.to: {{concat([{id: id, sub: sub, name: title, modified: now()}], filter(state.mine, it.id != id))}}

openMine.note: with: id, name, ask (empty for none)

revealMine.note: with: id ('' for the apps folder itself)

duplicateMine.note: with: id, name. The copy's folder is the first free <id>-copy, <id>-copy-2, ...

retitle.note: with: id, sub (where the app's files are in its folder: '' or '/json'), title, then (an action, run with the same variables). Sets the window title of its index.screen.json, as text, so the file keeps its layout

reidentify.note: with: id, sub, title, ask, then. Gives a copy's app.json (a starter has none) the new app's id and name, as text, so it keeps its data and permissions apart from the app it was copied from

createBlank.note: with: id, title, ask, then. A folder, and the blank starter in it

createCopy.note: with: id, title, ask, folder, then. A copy of an example's JSON folder and its assets, without its C++, into a json folder and an assets folder: its paths lead to the shared folder from there

createShared.note: with: id, title, ask. The fonts, add-ons and components the apps name as ../shared, brought up to date beside them

createFailed.note: with: id, why, keep (the folder isn't the new app's: it was there, or never made)

node.label: {{app.mine ? t('mine.openLabel', {name: app.name}) : t('apps.openLabel', {name: app.name, tagline: t('tagline.' + app.id)})}}

children.text: {{app.mine ? (app.modified > 0 ? t('mine.info', {folder: app.id, date: formatDate(app.modified, 'medium')}) : app.id) : t('tagline.' + app.id)}}
{{state.create.tried && computed.createError != '' ? t(computed.createError) : computed.slug != '' ? t('create.folder', {folder: computed.slug}) : t('create.nameHint')}}
